problem_restatement.input: The V85 ZEC Donchian route was granted live authority despite failing its frozen largest-winner robustness criterion, and its first live close lost after an 80-bps favorable excursion reversed into the capped stop.
problem_restatement.required_output: Test one fixed, externally sourced bidirectional trend mechanism with an early peak-harvesting exit; do not tune it on ZEC and do not grant execution authority from this experiment.
problem_restatement.success_criteria: The unchanged candidate passes development, validation, and holdout under nominal and stress all-taker costs, remains positive after its largest winner is removed, and has implementable causal research-to-runtime parity.

selection_disclosure.reason: Prior ZEC research opened the asset's full historical return path under other mechanisms. This exact UT-Bot signal and exit pair has not been replayed on ZEC, but no historical partition can now be described as pristine.

source_evidence_limitations: The local action plan reports independent reproduction but its named evidence bundle is absent from this snapshot, so those headline dollar projections are not independently reverified here.

The two reference scripts implement ATR on different candle sources; this experiment freezes the action plan's stated production interpretation: Wilder ATR13 on regular candles and Heikin-Ashi close as the trailing-stop source.
Hypertrader same-close fills are not transferred; Hypervector enters at the next executable fifteen-minute open.

data_contract.gap_policy: Only complete contiguous fifteen-minute and four-hour bars are eligible; recursive Heikin-Ashi, ATR, and UT-stop state reset after any source gap.

chronology.opening_rule: Run development first. Open validation only after a complete development pass, then holdout only after a complete validation pass. Do not change signal, exit, risk, cost, or support parameters between partitions.

candidate_contract.entry: fresh Heikin-Ashi source cross of the recursive UT stop on a completed four-hour bar; enter in the cross direction at the next available fifteen-minute open
candidate_contract.opposite_signal_policy: close and reverse at the next available fifteen-minute open
candidate_contract.initial_stop: 20 percent return-on-margin adverse move, equivalent to 400 price bps at five-times leverage

peak_harvest.execution: when a completed close falls to or below 80 percent of the best completed-close return after activation, exit at the next fifteen-minute open

support_criteria.required_directional_diagnostic: Neither side may account for more than 90 percent of gross profit in every opened partition unless the other side is explicitly retained observe-only before the next partition is opened.

falsifiers: source cadence exceeds the frozen missing-interval bound
development fails any support criterion under either friction profile
validation or holdout fails after an earlier partition passes
largest-winner removal makes net PnL non-positive
fewer than fifteen trades complete in any required partition
causal next-open timing removes the externally reported edge
research-to-runtime parity cannot be implemented without changing the candidate contract
